comments: Whole-site checks run on a schedule (WCAG 2.2 A/AA via axe-core; EN 301 549 web part mapping). The free browser extension checks a single page locally in the browser. WordPress plugin (GPLv2+) connects a site to the service. Free plan for one site; paid Pro and Agency subscriptions; one-off express report. Results are an automated check, not a full audit and not legal advice.
features: Automated accessibility checks of whole websites against WCAG 2.2 A/AA (axe-core in real Chromium) with weekly monitoring. Plain-language reports (HTML/PDF, 7 languages, white-label), fix steps for Shopify/WooCommerce, before/after comparison, API, WordPress plugin, free browser extension. Automated check, not a full audit.
title: Pandus
